title_en: How Do You Say It in Chinese

sentences.en: I'm studying Chinese in China, but I still don't know the names of a lot of things.
Today, my friend and I are in the classroom, and there's an apple on the table.
I ask my friend: "How do you say this in Chinese?"
My friend says: "This is called píngguǒ (apple)."
I see a cup this time, and ask her too: "What about this one?"
She said, "That's a cup — you've learned two new things today!"

quiz.q: What does "这个用中文怎么说？" mean?
a: How do you say this in Chinese?

quiz.q: What was the first new word the narrator learned?
How does the friend react at the end?

grammar.p: 这个用中文怎么说？（How do you say this in Chinese?）
grammar.e: This is the question to ask when you don't know a word — point at something and say this.
grammar.x: 这个用中文怎么说？— How do you say this in Chinese?

grammar.e: 叫 introduces the name of a thing right after 这个是 or on its own.
grammar.x: 这个叫苹果。— This is called 'píngguǒ'.

grammar.e: 又 goes before a verb to show an action happening again, already in the past or present.
grammar.x: 我又看见杯子。— I see a cup again.
